name: Post-drawdown stablecoin-inflow long (daily swing, multi-day re-entry)
rationale: MECHANISM: the staggered nature of post-crash re-entry means the inflow-led bounce can play out over several days, not just intraday. On a daily bar, a sustained stablecoin_net_flow_usd inflow following a multi-day drawdown (ret_Nd deeply negative) captures the slow re-entry wave: mint settlement latency plus staggered opportunistic buying deploy over a week. Distinct from the 4h/1h intraday variants by hold length and the multi-day selloff window. Other side = holders who capitulated over the drawdown and are done selling. DISCONFIRMER: remove the ret_Nd selloff precondition; if the edge survives, the flow spike is doing nothing and the selloff filter carries it. HARD KILL: if the same long fired on a deep bb_z washout ALONE matches net of fees, the on-chain flow feature is redundant.
catalyst: sustained stablecoin inflow after a multi-day drawdown
